findings.description: Matches REENTRANCY-ERC777: batchMint loops nftMinter.mint(...) which routes ERC1155 mints to a caller-controlled `recipient` (onERC1155Received hook fires mid-loop), with no ReentrancyGuard. The post-loop nudge snapshot (nudgeAmount, line 274) is read BEFORE the loop, but the actual nudge transfer (line 295) and dust sweep (line 299-305) read/act on live balances AFTER the reentrancy surface. A reentrant call from within the mint hook could itself qualify for and drain the SAME snapshotted pot before the outer payout, or re-enter to manipulate the live `remaining` sweep.
missingMitigations: snapshot mitigates self-refund but NOT cross-call pot drain via re-entry
findings.ledgerCorrelation: L-01 (submitted): batchMint lacks nonReentrant; onERC1155Received fires mid-loop. Still live post story-016 — snapshot does not add a reentrancy guard.

findings.description: Matches DOS-UNBOUNDED-LOOP: `for (uint256 i; i < count; ++i) nftMinter.mint(...)` iterates a caller-supplied `count` with no upper bound. Each iteration is a full external mint; a large `count` can exceed the block gas limit. Not a fund-loss DoS (caller pays their own gas) but the unbounded loop is the gate that the nudge payout (count >= nudgeSize) keys off, so it is in the cluster region.
findings.ledgerCorrelation: L-02 (submitted): uncapped count loop. Unchanged by story-016.

findings.description: Heuristic match to the DOUBLE-VOTING snapshot-vs-live class (the only snapshot-semantics pattern in the DB). story-016 snapshots `nudgeAmount = balanceOf(this)` BEFORE the loop (line 274) but the slippage check (line 290), the transfer (line 295) and the dust sweep `remaining = balanceOf(this)` (line 299) act on LIVE post-loop balances. The winner-take-all balance read remains front-runnable: a competing batcher mined first still claims the entire live pot, and the snapshot value `nudgeAmount` can diverge from what is actually transferable if the pot is drained between snapshot and transfer by a re-entrant or interleaved call. Snapshot fixes self-refund, NOT the live-balance race the acknowledged MEV finding describes.
missingMitigations: No per-claimant accounting (still reads full live/snapshot balance)
No commit-reveal or per-tx pot reservation against front-running
findings.ledgerCorrelation: M-01 (acknowledged): MEV / first-claimer front-run of winner-take-all nudge pot. story-016 explicitly does NOT close this (contract NatSpec lines 226-229 acknowledge the floor 'does NOT stop a front-runner from winning the pot'). Re-flagged as STILL-PRESENT, matches acknowledged status.

findings.description: Weak match to DIVISION-PRECISION / rounding. The dust gate `if (remaining / DUST_THRESHOLD != 0)` uses integer division as a >= threshold test: any `remaining` in [DUST_THRESHOLD, inf) refunds, anything below is retained. Behaviour is intentional (NatSpec lines 61-64, donate-forward) and below-threshold residue is swept by the next batch, so not a precision-loss bug. Flagged only because the integer-division-as-comparison idiom trips the DB signature; mitigations present. Sub-low / informational.
missingMitigations: none material — behaviour documented and intended
findings.ledgerCorrelation: Adjacent to design notes; no open ledger finding. Below medium-confidence reporting bar.
